rules.statement: The charge for making and serving copies of a plaint should be based on the scale in the third schedule to the Civil Procedure Code, unless the process used significantly deviates from manual methods.
rules.supporting_quote: "In this case, however, owing to the large number required, it was considered convenient to have the copies printed, in respect of which the actual cost was Rs. 35. The taxing officer reduced the item of Rs. 14,355 to Rs. 5,208.50 following a scale which differs from that laid down by the Civil Procedure Code."
